messages.subject: Spec review done: verdict FAIL, 7 blocking
messages.body: Ran /sc:spec-panel (critique, requirements+architecture) on specs/orca-worker-contract-spec.md and wrote the full panel result, boundary table and numbered findings to review/spec-panel.md without editing the spec. Verdict FAIL: the decision itself holds, but 7 blocking findings remain: P1 enables --unattended before gates and the no-posting rule exist (auggie-review would still post), the report contract conflicts with existing contracts (status 'success' vs 'succeeded', undefined or generated paths), retries reuse and overwrite the same output dir, AC-0.4 cannot pass in P0, AC-C1 contradicts P0's own Orca section, AC-C5's grep misses deleted bullet lines, and WC-10 cannot split subagent calls. Left for Task 6: revise the spec for F1-F7 per the Reviser brief; 8 minor notes are optional.
